settingsCreateAccount2.cloudFeature5: End-to-end encrypted sharing with other users
settingsCreateAccount2.cloudFeature7: Unlimited device sync on Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS and web
settingsCreateAccount2.localFeature5: Notes stored exclusively on this device
settingsCreateAccount2.readMoreSecurity: Read more about how we keep your data secure
settingsCreateAccount2.faq2Question: Do I need a Cloud Account?
settingsCreateAccount2.faq2Answer:
If you want to access your notes from multiple devices or you wish to share notes with other users, then yes.

If you want to keep your notes only on this device and not sync them anywhere, then no.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq3Question: Is my data safe in the Cloud?
settingsCreateAccount2.faq3Answer: Your data is encrypted before it leaves your device and even we cannot access your data.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq4Question: Can you help me recover my password?
settingsCreateAccount2.faq4Answer:
No, unfortunately we cannot help you recover your password.

Making this possible would substantially weaken your data security.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq5Question: Is my data safer with a Local Account?
settingsCreateAccount2.faq5Answer:
Technically a Local Account offers stronger privacy guarantees. However, with a well-chosen password the difference is academic.

And a Local Account does not help ensure your own access to the data in case of device loss or in an emergency situation.

Ultimately it depends on what you are trying to achieve.

subCustomerData.recommendFillOut: We recommend filling out all relevant fields if you need a tax invoice
subCustomerData.whyAsk: Why do we ask for this information?
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo:
We need your country of residence to manage VAT (this has no impact on the price you pay - the price you are shown is the final price).

We will use your email address solely to send you receipts, notifications of failed payments, and reminders prior to renewal. Your email address also serves as a last resort for canceling your subscription in case you lose access to your account.

We will never use your email address for marketing purposes, newsletters, or any other kind of unsolicited communication.

The above data is shared with our payment provider to process your payment, primarily for fraud prevention.

We will, however, never share your data with any other parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.

All data is handled in compliance with both GDPR and Swiss data protection laws, regardless of your country of residence.

subNewSubscriptionView.promoCopy:
The free tier isn't a trial - it's built to be fully usable and will always be here. 
But it's our subscribers who make it possible for Mimiri Notes to keep moving forward for everyone.
subNewSubscriptionView.faq1Question: Is the free tier really free?
subNewSubscriptionView.faq1Answer:
Yes, the free tier is free and will remain so.
For most use cases, the limits are more than adequate.
subNewSubscriptionView.faq2Question: Why would I choose a paid plan?
subNewSubscriptionView.faq2Answer: The main reason to subscribe is to support the ongoing development of Mimiri Notes.
